headline: 5 Solana addresses catalogued (stake pool account, bSOL token mint, BLZE governance token, SPL stake-pool program, reserve/fee account unknown); DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana chain.

findings.text: Solana Compass stake-pool directory page for stk9ApL5HeVAwPLr3TLhDXdZS8ptVu7zp6ov8HFDuMi surfaces both the stake pool account and bSOL pool token address bSo13r4TkiE4KumL71LsHTPpL2euBYLFx6h9HP3piy1. BLZE governance token BLZEEuZUBVqFhj8adcCFPJvPVCiCyVmh3hkJMrU8KuJA found via Solana Compass project page. No EVM-chain block explorer is applicable; Solana does not have a DeFiPunkd-supported chainId.

Protocol website (stake.solblaze.org) and docs (stake-docs.solblaze.org) fetched. No dedicated deployed-contracts page was found; the audits page links to GitHub audit PDFs but does not list deployed addresses. docs root returned 403.

Audit page at stake-docs.solblaze.org/protocol/audits fetched successfully. Eight audits listed covering the spl-stake-pool program from Solana Labs: Neodyme (4 audits: 2021-10, 2022-12, 2023-01, 2023-11), Halborn (2023-01), OtterSec (2023-01), Quantstamp (2021-10), Kudelski (2021-07). All audits target the shared spl-stake-pool program repo (github.com/solana-labs/solana-program-library) at specific commit SHAs, not a BlazeStake-specific repo. No in-scope addresses listed in the audit page itself.

protocol.github is recorded as '(none recorded)'. Searches did not surface a BlazeStake-owned GitHub org or deployment artifact file. The underlying stake-pool program lives at github.com/solana-labs/solana-program-library. No BlazeStake-specific deployment JSON found.
BlazeStake operates solely on Solana (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required.

The stake pool account stk9ApL5HeVAwPLr3TLhDXdZS8ptVu7zp6ov8HFDuMi is itself the factory-equivalent top-level account. Validator stake accounts are children; Solana Compass reports 200+ validators staked. Cap notice: downstream enumeration of individual validator stake accounts (potentially thousands) is out of scope for discovery; factory address is recorded.

Role taxonomy applied: stake pool account (pool), bSOL token mint (token), BLZE governance token (token), SPL stake-pool program (other — shared Solana Labs program). Manager/staker/fee-account authority addresses not yet surfaced — recorded in unknowns.

All three primary addresses (stk9ApL5..., bSo13r4..., BLZEEuZ...) trace to fetched search-result pages from Solana Compass and Solflare. SPL stake-pool program ID SPoo1Xe3dkm85969uHToDypTa5ZeZtZ9xZK6e9dMEFP (well-known Solana Labs program) not independently verified this run — recorded in unknowns with D8 code.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run walked protocol website, audits docs page, and search-grounded Solana Compass and Solflare pages. Five addresses catalogued: stake pool account, bSOL mint, BLZE governance token, and references to the shared spl-stake-pool program. Manager/staker authority and fee-account addresses remain unknown; DeFiPunkd read API is EVM-only and cannot be used for Solana. grade=unknown because on-chain state cannot be read via the DeFiPunkd API for Solana and manager/admin authorities were not surfaced from available sources.

protocol_metadata.about: BlazeStake is a fully non-custodial liquid staking protocol on Solana, supported by the Solana Foundation. Users stake SOL and receive bSOL tokens that appreciate in value each epoch as staking rewards compound, with options for instant unstake (using pool liquidity) or delayed unstake (converting bSOL to a standard stake account). The protocol uses the audited, open-source spl-stake-pool program developed by Solana Labs, delegating stake across 200+ validators to maximize network decentralization. bSOL holders also have governance voting power via the BLZE token for DAO treasury decisions and can participate in Solana ecosystem token airdrops.
